name: camphor (synthetic) + capsicum oleoresin + methyl salicylate
uses: Use For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with simple backache, arthritis, strains, bruises, and sprains.
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens, or if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days excessive irritation of the skin develops
